MOD = 10**9 + 7

def put(nr, p):
    if p == 0:
        return 1
    a = put(nr, p // 2)
    a = (a * a) % MOD
    if p % 2 == 1:
        a = (a * nr) % MOD
    return a

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    q = k
    if k == 0:
        print(put(p, p - 1))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(put(p, p))
        return
    n = 1
    while q != 1:
        q = (q * k) % p
        n += 1
    print(put(p, (p - 1) // n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
